title: Breaking the performance trade-offs in ammonia synthesis via spontaneous proton supply
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01570K, Paper
Qian Wu, Songzhu Luo, Pengfei Song, Chencheng Dai, Leonhard Tannesia, Longcheng Zhang, Kamal Elouarzaki, Shibo Xi, Zhichuan J. Xu
Anodic activation creates a specific CoFe-(oxy)hydroxide interface on spinel CoFe0.25Cr1.75O4, enabling spontaneous lattice-proton supply for fast nitrate hydrogenation and broad-window ammonia electrosynthesis.
